objective.text: Recognize that releasing a job does not return from the current handle method.

difficulty.rationale: Distinguish queue state mutation from returning out of the current handler.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.source:
<?php

use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Queue\Queueable;

class RetryLater implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Queueable;

    public function handle(): void
    {
        $this->release(30);

        echo 'continued';
    }
}

stem: The worker runs this handler once. What is printed during that invocation?

options.text: continued twice immediately because release invokes handle again recursively.
options.rationale: Release schedules later availability rather than recursively re-entering handle.
options.misconception: Release schedules later availability rather than recursively re-entering handle.

options.text: Nothing; release automatically returns from handle.
options.rationale: release does not perform a PHP return on behalf of its caller.
options.misconception: release does not perform a PHP return on behalf of its caller.

options.text: continued; release changes queue state but does not exit the method.
options.rationale: The following statement still runs unless the handler returns or otherwise stops control flow.

options.text: A fatal error because released jobs cannot execute any following PHP statement.
options.rationale: Queue state does not prohibit ordinary statements from running after release.
options.misconception: Queue state does not prohibit ordinary statements from running after release.
